نَهَى nahā 24 times; نُهِيَ nuhiya 8 times; يتَنَاهَون yatanāhawn 1 time; انْتَهَى ʾintahā 16 times; نَاهُون nāhūn 1 time; نُهَى nuhā 2 times; مُنْتَهَى muntahā 3 times and مُنْتَهُون muntahūn 1 time.

entries.label: انْتَهَى
entries.definitionHtml:
انْتَهَى ʾintahā [v. VIII intrans.] to desist, to cease, to hold back, to abstain, to stop

(8:38) إِنْ يَنْتَهُوا يُغْفَرْ لَهُمْ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ if they desist [from their unbelief] their past will be forgiven.

entries.label: مُنْتَهَى
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْتَهَى muntahā [v. n.; n. of place or time] ending, coming to an end; place of ending, a terminus or limit; time of ending, a term, a fixed term

(79:42–4) يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهَاهَا they ask you [Prophet] about the Hour: ‘When will it arrive?’, [but] what [knowledge] do you have of it that you can tell them? (or, why should they ask such a question? You [the Prophet] are [there for them to see as] one of its signs)–[known only] to your Lord is its time (timing; terminal/ending); *

(53:14) سِدْرَةُ المُنْتَهَى the Lote tree of maximum limit (see سِدْرَةُ sidratun)

entries.label: مُنْتَهُون
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْتَهُون muntahūn [pl. of act. part. مُنْتَهِي muntahı] one who desists, stops, ceases action, refrains

(5:91) فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُنْتَهُونَ will you not desist!

entries.label: نَاهُون
entries.definitionHtml:
نَاهُون nāhūn [pl. of act. part. نَاهِي nāhı] ones who forbid, ones who denounce an action as forbidden, ones who admonish against doing

(9:112) الآمِرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّاهُونَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ those who command goodness and forbid what is wrong.

entries.label: نَهَى
entries.definitionHtml:
نَهَى nahā a [v. trans.]

1 to forbid, to prohibit

(7:22) أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَنْ تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ did I not forbid you from that tree?

2 to restrain, to suppress, to hold back, to stop

(79:40) وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَى and as for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from whimisical desires

3 to restrain from, to ward off, to warn against

(11:116) فَلَوْلاَ كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِى الأَرْضِ if only there had been, among the generations before your time, people with a remnant [of good traditions] to ward against corruption on the earth!

entries.label: نُهَى
entries.definitionHtml:
نُهَى nuhā [n.] reasoning faculty, comprehension, discernment

(20:54) إِنَّ فِى ذَلِكَ لآَيَاتٍ لأُِولِي النُّهَى in this there are truly signs for those possessing reason.

entries.label: نُهِيَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نُهِيَ nuhiya [pass. v.] to be forbidden to, to be prohibited from

(4:161) وَأَخْذِهِمُ الرِّبَا وَقَدْ نُهُوا عَنْهُ and their taking usury when they had been forbidden it.

entries.label: يَتَنَاهَى
entries.definitionHtml:
يَتَنَاهَى yatanāhā [imperf. of v. VI تَنَاهَى tanāhā, intrans.] to forbid one another from, to prevent one another from, to restrain one another from doing

(5:79) كَانُوا لاَ يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَنْ مُنْكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ they did not prevent one another from any abomination they committed.
